A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PURGE and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F. Reordered sections and renumbered tables can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original RWKU experiments, adversarial and model-size analyses, training trajectories, and TOFU results in Appendix B.2.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds an experiment varying the entity-extraction LLM in Appendix B.3.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, synthetic corpus construction, top-50 entity selection, binary reward, and GRPO objective remain unchanged. The new extraction-model experiment varies a component's implementation within the existing procedure.

E1.justification: RWKU, TOFU, and the existing utility benchmarks and adversarial scenarios are retained. The new robustness experiment reuses Stephen King and the existing evaluation suite; it adds no dataset, task, or represented population.

E2.justification: The RWKU comparison retains Base, ICU, GA, DPO, NPO, and RT, and TOFU Table 2 retains all comparator rows. The new NER-model variants are component ablations, not additional competing unlearning methods.

E3.justification: Appendix B.3 introduces a single-target protocol varying five NER generators: Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Deepseek R1, GPT-5, Gemini 3, and Llama 3.1 405B. Existing benchmark splits, metrics, evaluated model sizes, and tabulated learning rates and epochs are retained.

E4.justification: New Appendix B.3 and Table 3 test dependence on the proprietary or open-source LLM used for entity extraction. This is a limited sensitivity study on Stephen King; the existing adversarial, model-size, training-dynamics, and qualitative analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: The target-averaging description and Table 1 standard-deviation reporting are retained. The new robustness table uses point estimates, as existing appendix results already did, without introducing seed counts, repeated-run information, confidence intervals, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds five rows of extraction-model results; for example, forget-set QA scores range from .200 for Deepseek R1 to .338 for Gemini 3. Tables 1–2, Figures 1–6, and the qualitative outputs retain their results. These are new component-variation results, not improvements to the earlier aggregate scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, theorems, corollary, and Appendix A proofs are retained. Changes such as replacing 'Bregman distance' with 'Bregman divergence' do not alter the mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same claims about verifiable GRPO unlearning, theoretical guarantees, token efficiency, fluency, robustness, and utility retention. The rewritten conclusion removes some repeated numerical detail without changing those core contributions.

C2.justification: v1 attributes adversarial robustness to suppression in latent representations. v3 revises that explanation and adds Section 6, explicitly acknowledging that internal knowledge erasure remains unestablished. It substantially expands limitations concerning entity coverage, semantic paraphrases, sparse rewards, incomplete adversarial validation, and applicability to reasoning models.

D1.justification: v3 adds resource disclosures describing setup instructions, reproduction scripts, publication-time code release, and a HuggingFace collection of unlearned checkpoints. Section 5.1 changes the reported GPU from A100 to H200 while retaining approximately 350 hours; this does not establish rerunning. Existing hyperparameter tables and extraction prompts are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged. Citation years, author details, and publication venues are updated, including preprint-to-publication changes for existing references.

P1.justification: v3 copyedits prose, separates contribution items, rewrites the conclusion, adds Discussion and end-matter statements, and swaps the TOFU and training-dynamics subsections in Appendix B. The original technical exposition and overall organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds the NER robustness table and relocates the TOFU table with its reordered subsection. Existing figures retain their plotted content, while placement, captions, and surrounding layout receive limited adjustments.

improvement.justification: The new discussion improves scientific qualification by distinguishing observable suppression from demonstrated knowledge erasure. The extraction-model sensitivity study and resource disclosures add useful support. These gains are limited: the new study covers one target without uncertainty estimates, and the reproducibility statement does not fill the missing PURGE hyperparameter details in Appendix C.2.
